interfaces.pressure_and_damage: Visual revisions do not implement pressure, authoritative damage, refit or power. Native damage preview unsupported. Source closed-shell cells are separate editor occupancy representation.
interfaces.cutaway: Every mapped asset retains category roof; decal example planes inherit roof visibility in staged runtime.

material_roles.pale_dark_burgundy: Pigmented satin polymer/enamel, metallic0, UV roughness~.29
material_roles.cyan_amber: Principled emission; fixture descriptors separate renderer proposal, no authoritative power grant
material_roles.maps: Tangent mapped normal relief on pale/red/steel surfaces; separate calm micro-normal on dark central surfaces. UV roughness controls satin specular response. 3 PNG maps embedded/shared with validated tangents; basepigment,geometry unchanged.

stats.basis: Measured current datums and reference composition; percomponent bounds in components.json
No gameplay balances inferred from appearance

lights.basis: Sparse cyan recessed source surfaces and amber utilities; bounded short-range renderer descriptors. No pointlight emitted by text decals.
lights.status: Eight bounded spotlights verified through actual Babylon createEquipmentLighting API. RGB,position,direction,angle,range,intensity validated. Actual appearance pending browser.

proxy.basis: Union of individually closed evaluated authored meshes at .0625m BVH scanline sampling. Sampling copies use constant material; subcell source details omitted explicitly in each samples.json. Source visual mesh/materials untouched.
proxy.placement_gate: placement-validation.json passes all73 in complete current ship, no broadphase exemptions.

changes_from_r003: Calm dark-material normalmap removes undesigned centerfield strokes
Valid localroofspot descriptors enable illumination previously silentlyskipped
